layers.label: Structure
layers.what: What contains what: the site, its modules, groups and parts.

layers.label: Notes and decisions
layers.what: Which note describes what, which documents link to which, and which decision explains a part.

layers.label: Code dependencies
layers.what: Which module or screen builds on which shared area, or another part.

layers.label: Components
layers.what: Which shared components a module, area or screen uses.

layers.label: Data model
layers.what: Content types, the fields that point at each other, hooks, Admin screens and who reads or writes them.

layers.label: API
layers.what: Endpoints and server actions, and the content types they expose.

layers.label: AI agent tools
layers.what: The tools AI agents call through MCP, and the content types they reach.

layers.label: Jobs and schedules
layers.what: Work that runs on a timer or a queue, and what it reaches.

layers.label: Libraries
layers.what: Outside packages and the parts that use them.

layers.label: Agent skills
layers.what: The procedures agents follow, and what they point to.

layers.label: Roles and AI agents
layers.what: Role guides and agent definitions, and who owns what.

layers.label: Rules and guidelines
layers.what: Conventions and the rule files that load them for agents.

layers.label: CI and checks
layers.what: Workflows, their checks and what starts them.

block.what: A page-builder or rich-text block an editor places.

business-rule.what: One rule a note states, with the tests that protect it.

check.what: A mechanical gate: a required check or a script.

collection.what: A CMS content type with many documents.

endpoint.what: An HTTP address that answers with data, not a page.

feature.what: One piece with its own logic, inside a module or area.

global.what: A CMS content type with one document.

group.what: A heading the scanner makes to hold a kind of thing (all skills, all roles).

job.what: Work the app runs on its own schedule or queue.

library.what: An outside package the application depends on.

mcp-tool.what: A tool an AI agent calls through the MCP address.

note.what: A knowledge note next to the code it describes.

page-cluster.what: Screens that share the first part of their address (all of /events, say).

process-doc.what: A document under docs/process/ on how work is planned and tracked.

rule.what: A rule file Claude Code loads when the work touches matching files.

scheduled-task.what: A task that runs by the clock outside the app.

screen.what: A page route a visitor opens.

shared-component.what: A component of the UI kit or rich text.

calls.what: the routes reference and the code

contains.what: folders and the screens and content-type references

depends-on.what: written only when no import or reference shows it

edits.what: An Admin screen where editors change a content type.

hooks.what: A hook written in one area runs when a content type of another area changes.

joins.what: A content type reads the documents of another that point back at it (join field).

mirrors.what: A generated rule file that is a copy of a note or a guideline.

references.what: A field of one content type points at another (relationship or upload field).

writes.what: the content-type reference and the code

nodes.summary: **The API carries the same access rules as the admin:** a visitor reads published documents only, and a non-staff create becomes a held suggestion (`src/payload.config.roles.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.protectedFields.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.reviewQueueApi.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **Answers under `/api/` say `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`** (`API_HEADERS`, pattern `/api/:path((?!media/file/).*)` in `next.config.js`): not a path starting `/api/media/file/` (uploads, kept indexable for image search), not a bare `/api`, and no page outside `/api/`. nodes.summary: **Nobody learns whether an account exists.** Sign-up answers the same for a new and a used email, sign-in has one failure, forgot password answers at once and sends later; every action returns a fixed code, never Payload's text (`data/failures.ts`, `use-cases/requestPasswordReset.ts`, `domain/types.ts`; `actions.signUp.test.ts`, `actions.passwordReset.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **A passkey challenge is used once,** the counter only rises, the handle is a random value never the email, and a wrong or foreign passkey gets the same `failed` (`domain/passkeys.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`, `data/passkeyChallenges.payload.test.ts`, `use-cases/signInWithPasskey.refused.payload.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **Passkey sign-in refuses a locked, unverified or agent owner,** by the same rule as provider sign-in (`canSignInTo` in `domain/socialSignIn.ts`, asked in `domain/passkeys.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`). nodes.name: **Passkey limits:** at most 10 per account and a label of up to 60…
nodes.summary: **Passkey limits:** at most 10 per account and a label of up to 60 characters, letters, numbers, spaces and a few marks, so a note email can carry no link; asking to add one is limited per connection and per account, never site-wide (`domain/passkeys.ts`, `domain/requestLimits.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`, `domain/passkeyLabel.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **Deleting an account deletes its passkeys** (`cms/deletePasskeysWithAccount.ts`; `cms/deletePasskeysWithAccount.test.ts`). Removing a passkey needs no passkey switch and always comes from the session's own account (`use-cases/removePasskey.ts`; `use-cases/removePasskey.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Removing the last passkey is allowed:** every account keeps a…
nodes.summary: **Removing the last passkey is allowed:** every account keeps a password or forgot-password, so nobody is locked out (`use-cases/removePasskey.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **Sign-up never makes an admin;** only Payload's first registration on an empty database does, and a Google create on an empty database is a guest (`cms/firstAccountIsAdmin.ts`; `cms/signUpFirstAccount.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.roles.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: **An MCP key is not a signed-in account:** only a user of the users collection counts (`getSessionPayloadUser` in `data/session.ts`).

nodes.summary: **Public email forms are limited:** per connection, then the robot check, then site-wide (sign-up: 5 an hour per connection and 20 site-wide; forgot password: 5 and 30); counts are in memory, one PM2 process (`use-cases/guardPublicRequest.ts`, `domain/requestLimits.ts`). nodes.name: **An agent sees only allowlisted fields,** each collection's…
nodes.summary: **An agent sees only allowlisted fields,** each collection's allowlist checked against the generated types; related documents become ids, `meta` keeps only title and description, and every answer is rebuilt from that view, so no personal data reaches the model (`cms/agentViews.ts`, `domain/agentView.ts`; `domain/agentView.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.agentAccess.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **An agent never publishes or changes content:** over MCP it finds…
nodes.summary: **An agent never publishes or changes content:** over MCP it finds published events, posts and categories, writes its own runs and calls two tools; `submitSuggestion` stores a held `suggested` draft, `reportItem` adds a review item for staff (`cms/mcp.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentTools.test.ts`). The tools are listed in the [MCP tools reference](../../../docs/reference/mcp-tools.md).

nodes.name: **A suggestion is stored once:** the same source id or fingerprint…
nodes.summary: **A suggestion is stored once:** the same source id or fingerprint answers `duplicate` with the stored id, also when two calls race; `externalId` (a lowercase source id, a colon, the source's own id: `EXTERNAL_ID` in `domain/suggestion.ts`) and `contentHash` are unique and the slug ends with the start of the hash (`cms/tools/submitSuggestion.ts`, `domain/suggestion.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentTools.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A suggestion's shape is checked before anything is stored:** an…
nodes.summary: **A suggestion's shape is checked before anything is stored:** an unknown category slug is refused, never created; a malformed `<Chart>`, `<FactTabs>` or `<SectionTabs>` tag refuses the call; an event needs `startsAt` and an update or cancellation names its target; an event's day and times come from `startsAt`, `endsAt` and `allDay` in the site timezone, and an end on another day is dropped; the tools' schemas and the agents' contract in `intelligence/schemas/` give the same verdicts (`cms/tools/schemas.ts`, `domain/suggestion.ts`, #633; `domain/suggestion.test.ts`, `cms/tools/schemas.contract.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.chartSuggestion.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.factTabsSuggestion.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.sectionTabsSuggestion.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A suggestion's text and lists have length caps,** because Payload…
nodes.summary: **A suggestion's text and lists have length caps,** because Payload checks a title's length only on publish, not on a draft. The main ones: title (the shared `TITLE_MAX_LENGTH`), body 12,000, card summary 160, summary 1,000, at most 2 categories and 5 evidence items; `SUGGESTION_CAPS` in `domain/suggestion.ts` holds all of them, including the venue, address, source, category slug, source id, run id, evidence and flag caps (#633; `domain/suggestion.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A suggestion's picture is the first category's `defaultImage`,**…
nodes.summary: **A suggestion's picture is the first category's `defaultImage`,** else the nearest parent's, else the next category's, else none; a post's `summary` fills only its search-engine description and an event's its description (`cms/tools/submitSuggestion.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentSuggestionCards.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A key is the only credential and it can be narrowed, not widened:**…
nodes.summary: **A key is the only credential and it can be narrowed, not widened:** keys are admin-only, each bound to an account that must still have the agent role at each request; collection access decides what it may do and Admin's per-key boxes only narrow that. Limits: 120 requests a minute per connection, then 60 a minute per key, then 429, counted in memory (`cms/apiKeys.ts`, `cms/mcp.ts`, `domain/mcpLimits.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentAccess.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.agentProbes.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A run belongs to its agent:** the `agent` of a run and of a review…
nodes.summary: **A run belongs to its agent:** the `agent` of a run and of a review item is set by the server from the key's account; a run's identity (`RUN_IDENTITY`) is written once and later updates keep it; an agent sees only its own runs (another's is "not found") and uses them to resume from its source cursors; admins may change identity fields (`cms/agentRuns.ts`, `cms/agentReviewItems.ts`, `domain/runs.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentAccess.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Reports never overwrite each other:** each adds one document under…
nodes.summary: **Reports never overwrite each other:** each adds one document under the agent's own run; staff read every item, an agent only its own, only admins change or delete one (`cms/tools/reportItem.ts`; `src/payload.config.agentTools.test.ts`). The access migration rolls back and applies again (`src/payload.config.agentMigration.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Size:** over 50 rows, or a name, value or total over its limit, is…
nodes.summary: **Size:** over 50 rows, or a name, value or total over its limit, is refused with 413; rows that are not text, number or true/false get 400. Staff are held to it too (`cms/limitSubmissionSize.ts`, `domain/submissionSize.ts`; `domain/submissionSize.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Rate:** 5 submissions an hour per connection, then 429, counted in…
nodes.summary: **Rate:** 5 submissions an hour per connection, then 429, counted in memory (one process); with no known IP it does not apply. Emails also pass a site-wide cap of 30 an hour; past it they are dropped, the submission is kept and one warning an hour is logged (`cms/rateLimits.ts`, `domain/rateLimits.ts`; `cms/rateLimits.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Robot check:** a missing or wrong token is refused with 400 and…
nodes.summary: **Robot check:** a missing or wrong token is refused with 400 and only the log says why. It is off while Turnstile keys are unset (a production deploy refuses to go out without them unless `ALLOW_NO_ROBOT_CHECK` is set). Admins and editors skip the rate limit and the robot check, not the size check (`cms/verifyHumanSubmission.ts`; `cms/verifyHumanSubmission.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Only staff-chosen recipients get mail:** an email whose to, cc or…
nodes.summary: **Only staff-chosen recipients get mail:** an email whose to, cc or bcc comes from the submission is dropped, so is one with no matching setting; a Reply-To is kept only as one plain address, and a From built from submitted data is blanked (`domain/formEmails.ts`; `domain/formEmails.test.ts`, `cms/deliveryToRecipient.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A message reaches the team only after its sender confirms:**…
nodes.summary: **A message reaches the team only after its sender confirms:** unconfirmed is held; confirmed before, or a form with no email field, is sent at once; a form that asks for an email but got no valid one sends nothing. Each sent email ends with a "Sender's email: confirmed." line, held emails are cleared before sending, so a repeated click sends nothing twice and one failure stops no other (`domain/senderEmail.ts` `toEmailDelivery`, `cms/heldEmails.ts`; `domain/senderEmail.test.ts`, `cms/deliveryToRecipient.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **The sender's fields cannot be forged:** `senderEmail` is the first…
nodes.summary: **The sender's fields cannot be forged:** `senderEmail` is the first plain address in the form, `emailConfirmed` is the confirmer's answer; both are overwritten on every create and `heldEmails` is cleared (`cms/senderEmail.ts`; `cms/senderEmail.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Retention:** never a message on hold (`retentionHold` cannot be set…
nodes.summary: **Retention:** never a message on hold (`retentionHold` cannot be set on create and needs a reason, `cms/retentionHold.ts`). A message waiting for a click goes 48 hours after it was sent; any other 12 months after its sender's last message, or after it was sent when it has no address. The delete re-checks hold and confirmation, so a hold or a click meanwhile keeps the message; a kept message also keeps its confirmed address (`keepSendersWithMessages`) (`domain/retention.test.ts`, `cms/retention.test.ts`).

nodes.name: The order and the fields the hooks add
nodes.summary: The order and the fields the hooks add: `cms/formBuilder.test.ts`; the form's fields, errors and note: `ui/FormBlock.client.test.tsx`, `ui/formSchema.test.ts`; the real confirmer and listener: `src/payload.config.confirmation.test.ts`.

nodes.summary: **Sections follow the category lists.** Entries group in the list's order, keep `order` within a group, and an entry with no category or an unlisted one goes under General (FAQ) or Other (resources); the option lists and the headings are one definition so they cannot drift (`domain/categories.ts`, `domain/sections.ts`; `domain/categories.test.ts`, `domain/sections.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Resources sit in five groups,** each its own page; every category…
nodes.summary: **Resources sit in five groups,** each its own page; every category is in exactly one group (Other and unlisted ones in Community and family); an empty group still has its page; an unknown group is not found (`domain/groups.ts`).

nodes.name: **A portrait needs its own credit.** `photoCredit` is required once a…
nodes.summary: **A portrait needs its own credit.** `photoCredit` is required once a photo is set and must leave out "Photo:", which the card adds. It shows only for elected officials, when the photo is an image and `photoCredit` is set; the card draws the resource's credit and source, never the media item's (`domain/resourcePortrait.ts`, `cms/resources.ts`; `domain/resourcePortrait.test.ts`, `data/queries.resources.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Links are web addresses.** `url`, up to three extra links (label…
nodes.summary: **Links are web addresses.** `url`, up to three extra links (label and URL both required) and the photo source must start with `http://` or `https://`, and the card drops one that fails (`domain/resourceUrl.ts`, `ui/ResourceCard.tsx`; `domain/resourceUrl.test.ts`, `ui/ResourceCard.test.tsx`).

nodes.summary: **A note keeps portraits from reading as an endorsement** under the Elected Officials heading (`RESOURCE_SECTION_NOTES`, #393).

nodes.name: **FAQ answer links keep their address,** or fall back to plain text…
nodes.summary: **FAQ answer links keep their address,** or fall back to plain text when the reader may not see the target (`data/queries.ts`; `data/queries.faq.test.ts`). The page emits schema.org `FAQPage` data (`ui/faqJsonLd.ts`; `ui/faqJsonLd.test.ts`) and its rows open without JavaScript (`ui/FaqList.test.tsx`).

nodes.summary: **`order` is a sidebar number,** 99 by default, lower first (`cms/orderField.ts`; `cms/orderField.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Upcoming means dated today or later in the site timezone…
nodes.summary: **Upcoming means dated today or later in the site timezone (`SITE_TIMEZONE`, see [shared helpers](../../platform/lib/README.md));** past means before today, dates are day-only. Upcoming lists run soonest first, 12 a page; past lists newest first, 9 a page (`data/scope.ts`, `domain/scope.ts`; `data/scope.test.ts`, `domain/scope.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Cursor paging skips and repeats nothing** when events change…
nodes.summary: **Cursor paging skips and repeats nothing** when events change (`data/queries.keyset.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Only published events show; cancelled ones stay** listed, counted,…
nodes.summary: **Only published events show; cancelled ones stay** listed, counted, in "Load more" and the sidebar and openable, marked cancelled, with no register button (`data/listing.ts`; `use-cases/cancelledEvents.test.ts`). A past event's page has no register button and says "This event has passed."; a cancelled one says only that it is cancelled; today's keeps its button (`isPastEvent`; `src/app/(frontend)/events/[slug]/page.test.tsx`, #1012).

nodes.name: **An event with `officialBody` is an official meeting** (the bodies,…
nodes.summary: **An event with `officialBody` is an official meeting** (the bodies, City of Madison and Dane County, are `OFFICIAL_BODIES` in `domain/officialMeetings.ts`): labelled wherever it shows, with the body's `https://` agenda link on its page and the body as organizer in structured data; an agenda link that is not `https://` is refused (`domain/officialMeetings.ts`, `ui/OfficialAgenda.tsx`; `domain/officialMeetings.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **The "this week" strip:** a row is `all`, `official` or one…
nodes.summary: **The "this week" strip:** a row is `all`, `official` or one category; a window of 1 to 31 days (default 7) from today; at most 4 rows, 1 to 6 events each; empty rows are hidden, and with none left it shows a message (`domain/thisWeek.ts`, `data/thisWeek.ts`; `domain/thisWeek.test.ts`, `use-cases/findEventsThisWeek.test.ts`, `data/mappers.thisWeek.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A title band photo with no crop for a screen size uses the nearest…

nodes.name: **A rate not set for a year is carried from the year before,** and…
nodes.summary: **A rate not set for a year is carried from the year before,** and the line says which year; a rate that is empty or not above zero is "not set", never zero, and a year with any rate unset has no shares of its own, so no bill is drawn ("No rate yet") (`billRates.ts`, `src/platform/lib/billShare.ts` `fillFromEarlier`; `billRates.test.ts`, `RatesPanel.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **Two years tell one story** (#1121)
nodes.summary: **Two years tell one story** (#1121): the typed value is the home's value in the latest year; an earlier year prices the same home by the average-home ratio (`homeInYear`), and the increase is the City's tax in the year less the year before's, each rounded to the dollar as the cards show it, so the later card less the earlier card is the line, for any home. A year with no average home leaves the value as typed and shows no increase (`billFigures.ts`, `cityTax.ts`; `BillShareTwoYears.client.test.tsx`, `billFigures.test.ts`, `cityTax.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **The Estimate tag is a button that says why** the figures are an…
nodes.summary: **The Estimate tag is a button that says why** the figures are an estimate (they cannot know credits, exemptions, special assessments); it shows on the answer card and the whole bill in every year and on the rates panel only for a year not all final (`PanelHeader.tsx`, `billRates.ts` `ratesBadgeFor`, #1417; `BillShareToast.client.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **The whole bill reads like a receipt:** one row per body, the…
nodes.summary: **The whole bill reads like a receipt:** one row per body, the largest share first (equal shares keep City, schools, county, college), each with name, percent, dollars and a bar on one shared scale; the total is the last row; the lines add up exactly to the City's slice in whole dollars (`billShareView.ts`, `src/platform/lib/billShare.ts`, #1196, #1202; `billShareView.test.ts`, `BillShareOrder.client.test.tsx`, `BillShareBar.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A note shows by its condition** (always, when the tab has more than…
nodes.summary: **A note shows by its condition** (always, when the tab has more than one year, in a year with a proposed rate, or when a rate is missing); a note not showing still takes its room so an open row never changes height; Admin refuses a blank its condition cannot fill (`billShareNotes.ts`; `billShareNotes.test.ts`, `BillDetails.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A tab with a bill is drawn in one column** in a fixed order, the…
nodes.summary: **A tab with a bill is drawn in one column** in a fixed order, the tab's heading up to 48 characters, and its charts keep their table for screen readers only (`BillShare.client.tsx`, `FactTabs.tsx`; `FactTabsBill.test.tsx`, `BillShare.client.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: Counting and one flash per settled bill
nodes.summary: Counting and one flash per settled bill: `BillShareCounting.client.test.tsx`; the City's breakdown row: `BillShareCity.client.test.tsx`, `BreakdownRow.test.tsx`; the estimator: `RoughEstimator.test.tsx`, `BillShareEstimate.client.test.tsx`; the block's fields: `billShareBlockConfig.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.billShareNotes.test.ts`.

nodes.name: **The robot check fails closed.** It is off until both Turnstile keys…
nodes.summary: **The robot check fails closed.** It is off until both Turnstile keys are set; any error refuses; action and hostname are checked (extra accepted hostnames come from `TURNSTILE_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES`); no IP is sent; the widget appears only when Cloudflare asks (`interaction-only`) and a token is single use, so `useRobotCheck` renews it after each attempt (`turnstile/turnstileVerifier.ts`, `turnstile/useRobotCheck.client.ts`, decision 0003; `turnstile/turnstileVerifier.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Likely-human clicks** (#975)
nodes.summary: **Likely-human clicks** (#975): one listener sends the Umami event `likely-human-click` for a click the browser made for a person (`isTrusted`) on a button or a link to another site, once per element per visit; same-site, `mailto:` and `tel:` links, disabled buttons, scripted clicks, automated browsers and Do Not Track send nothing. It holds no cookie or identifier, only the label (60 characters) or the other site's host (`analytics/likelyHumanClicks.ts`; `analytics/likelyHumanClicks.test.ts`, `analytics/LikelyHumanClicks.client.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **The counter is cookie-free and off in the admin**…
nodes.summary: **The counter is cookie-free and off in the admin** (`analytics/umami.test.ts`, `analytics/UmamiScript.test.tsx`, `src/app/nextConfigEnv.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A tab title shows the site name once:** the title is the SEO title,…
nodes.summary: **A tab title shows the site name once:** the title is the SEO title, else the document's own, else the site name set as the whole title, since the layout's template adds the name after any other (`seo/generateMeta.ts`, `seo/siteName.ts`, #1011; `seo/generateMeta.test.ts`). Defaults call Sprecher East an unofficial site, never an association (`seo/organizationJsonLd.ts`, #1010).

nodes.name: **A failure never logs personal data:** `runUseCase` catches, logs…
nodes.summary: **A failure never logs personal data:** `runUseCase` catches, logs only the error's class name and returns the fallback; `runAction` turns a throw into a failure code and logs it only for `server-error` (`service/runUseCase.ts`, #521; `service/runUseCase.test.ts`, `seo/privateAddress.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Every theme sets every token,** in light and dark when the token is…
nodes.summary: **Every theme sets every token,** in light and dark when the token is marked `both` (`diagram-marker`, `radius`, `type-fine` and `type-list-row` are `base`, set once); dark inherits a light token it leaves out (`tokens.ts`, `themeFile.ts`; `themes.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Contrast is checked in both modes:** text pairs 4.5:1, chart marks…
nodes.summary: **Contrast is checked in both modes:** text pairs 4.5:1, chart marks and control borders 3:1, tinted and scrim backgrounds included; the pale breakdown steps sit outside the 3:1 pairs and carry a thin outline and their amount as text (`CHART_PAIRS` in `tokens.ts`, #659, #866; `themes.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Tones:** `info` is blue, work that is open is green (`success`),…
nodes.summary: **Tones:** `info` is blue, work that is open is green (`success`), done is purple (`done`), each with a `-strong` text colour; orange text is `accent-strong`, since the plain accent is too light to read (`tokens.ts`, #818, #946, #1118; `themes.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **Text over a photo stays readable:** a title band's photo is faded…
nodes.summary: **Text over a photo stays readable:** a title band's photo is faded by `BAND_PHOTO_ALPHA` and `BAND_SCRIM_ALPHA` and the glass panel is darkened by `GLASS_SCRIM_ALPHA`, so the title passes WCAG AA over a black or a white photo and glass text over a bright gray (#1024, #1278; `themes.test.ts`, `src/platform/ui/GlassPanel.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **No raw colours in classes:** lint rejects raw palette classes and…
nodes.summary: **No raw colours in classes:** lint rejects raw palette classes and hex or rgb values (`eslint.theme.config.mjs`). A theme that sets no options gets every default (`options.test.ts`); the default theme is undecorated (`registry.test.ts`, `ThemeDecoration.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: The stored or system theme is set on `<html>` when nothing else did…
nodes.summary: The stored or system theme is set on `<html>` when nothing else did (`ThemeProvider.client.test.tsx`); chart effects are screen-only and print keeps colours (`chartReveal.test.ts`, `chartPrint.test.ts`); rich-text colours cover every colour the typography plugin reads (`prose.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **The kit, not raw tags:** pages and modules never use raw `a`,…
nodes.summary: **The kit, not raw tags:** pages and modules never use raw `a`, `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `details`, `summary` or `img`; the native element lives inside a kit component, and lint bans them elsewhere (guard rail 2; `eslint.ui-kit.config.mjs`).

nodes.name: **A `Disclosure` a reader opens is scrolled into view** just far…
nodes.summary: **A `Disclosure` a reader opens is scrolled into view** just far enough to show its end with a small gap; a box taller than the screen stops with its summary under the sticky header (and the "On this page" bar), so the top wins; closing never scrolls; a box can name a `revealAnchor` that must not go above the header; a box with another `Disclosure` right under it keeps room to show that one's summary (`reveal.client.ts`, `revealShift.ts`, `Disclosure.tsx`, #1152, #1154, #1178; `revealShift.test.ts`, `reveal.client.test.ts`, `Disclosure.anchor.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A chevron turns only for its own box,** so boxes can nest…
nodes.summary: **A chevron turns only for its own box,** so boxes can nest (`Disclosure.test.tsx`, #967); a `listRow` expands over 500 ms (`Disclosure.expand.test.tsx`, #1163).

nodes.name: **Every tab has a link of its own:** choosing one puts `#<anchor>` in…
nodes.summary: **Every tab has a link of its own:** choosing one puts `#<anchor>` in the address (replacing history so Back leaves the page); a name repeated by a later tabbed block is numbered `-2`, `-3`; a link to a heading inside a closed tab opens that tab first; the named tab shows before any script runs through CSS keyed on the target (`Tabs.client.tsx`, `theme/tabs.css`, #1097, #1309, #1333; `Tabs.client.test.tsx`, `TabsLinks.client.test.tsx`, `TabsContentLinks.client.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **The "On this page" menu needs at least 3 sections** and highlights…
nodes.summary: **The "On this page" menu needs at least 3 sections** and highlights the last heading above a reading line (`onThisPage.ts`, `OnThisPage.client.tsx`; `OnThisPage.client.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **Text on a photo stays readable:** `GlassPanel` is the one…
nodes.summary: **Text on a photo stays readable:** `GlassPanel` is the one frosted-glass look and keeps 4.5:1 text over a very bright photo; a title band photo is dimmed so its title meets WCAG AA (`GlassPanel.tsx`, `BandBackdrop.tsx`, #1278, #1024; `GlassPanel.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A brand mark is never altered:** `BrandLogo` draws a provider's…
nodes.summary: **A brand mark is never altered:** `BrandLogo` draws a provider's logo exactly as supplied, takes no class, and is the one place literal logo colours are allowed (`BrandLogo.tsx`, #1365; `BrandLogo.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **`Button` with `loading` ignores clicks but stays focusable;**…
nodes.summary: **`Button` with `loading` ignores clicks but stays focusable;** `ProgressBar` needs a `label` and clamps its value (`Button.tsx`, `ProgressBar.tsx`, #939); `Alert` announces itself unless `live={false}` (`Alert.tsx`).

nodes.name: **Toasts sit under the sticky header in the page** and above…
nodes.summary: **Toasts sit under the sticky header in the page** and above everything at the screen's bottom (`Toast.client.tsx`, #1392; `Toast.client.test.tsx`). Each component's behavior and accessibility: its `*.test.tsx` beside it.

nodes.name: **Every chart carries its numbers as a real table** under "Show the…
nodes.summary: **Every chart carries its numbers as a real table** under "Show the numbers" (closed by default, or for screen readers only with `numbers="screen-reader"`, as in a fact tab); a chart may leave its title and takeaway to screen readers and draws no caption when it has nothing to say (`ChartDataTable.tsx`, `ChartCaption.tsx`, #980, #1144; `ChartDataTable.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **An adapter passes one contract:** no `style`, no colour literals,…
nodes.summary: **An adapter passes one contract:** no `style`, no colour literals, real text, axe clean (`chartAdapter.contract.tsx`; `chartAdapter.contract.test.tsx`, `chartRegistry.test.ts`, `chartLibraries.lint.test.ts`). The browser never gets a library or the spec rules through the zoom (`ChartZoom.imports.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A breakdown is drawn at full width:** a grid of squares each worth…
nodes.summary: **A breakdown is drawn at full width:** a grid of squares each worth a fixed dollar amount (whole squares by largest remainder; `hideSquares` leaves the grid out), ranked bars with the main pieces nested under their area, the rest under "See the smaller pieces", colour following size (`chart-ramp-1` to `-7`). Bar length is share times one shared scale, so a dollar is the same length in every breakdown (`adapters/breakdown/`, #866, #943; `adapters/breakdown/breakdownAdapter.test.tsx`, `chartPalette.test.ts`).

nodes.name: **A bar or stacked chart is drawn large for readers who see poorly:**…
nodes.summary: **A bar or stacked chart is drawn large for readers who see poorly:** text at 18 units in a 320-unit drawing, so 16px or more on a 320px phone; bars share one scale shown as short ticks (`adapters/visx/barLayout.ts`, #1206; `adapters/visx/barLayout.test.ts`, `adapters/visx/visxAdapter.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A bill's rows line up:** one grid of name, percent and dollars…
nodes.summary: **A bill's rows line up:** one grid of name, percent and dollars shared by the rows and the total, the dollar column wide enough for the widest amount, bars on the largest slice's scale (`ShareBill.tsx`, #1163, #1196; `ShareBill.test.tsx`); a strip is one `role="img"` label naming every part and drawing nothing when no part has a share (`ShareStrip.tsx`, #1266; `ShareStrip.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **An area chart never dips below a flat stretch:** the curve is…
nodes.summary: **An area chart never dips below a flat stretch:** the curve is monotone, a series of zeros or a `max` of 0 is the flat baseline, one value is a dot, and it has a text label listing every value (`AreaChart.tsx`, `src/platform/lib/smoothPath.ts`, #1190; `AreaChart.test.tsx`).

nodes.name: **A heat map says all of its values in text,** marks today with a…
nodes.summary: **A heat map says all of its values in text,** marks today with a ring, and a day that is not enabled is a muted, slashed square that cannot be pressed (`HeatMap.tsx`, #1191, #1205; `HeatMap.test.tsx`, `HeatMapPeriod.test.tsx`, `HeatMapKey.test.tsx`). `PeriodNav` keeps a direction that cannot go on focusable (`aria-disabled`) (`PeriodNav.test.tsx`, #1218).

nodes.name: **A legend's columns** are `auto`, `one` or `fit` (by its own width)…
nodes.summary: **A legend's columns** are `auto`, `one` or `fit` (by its own width) (`Legend.tsx`, #1333; `Legend.test.tsx`, `chartLegends.test.ts`).

nodes.summary: The schedule the pipeline settings state; what starts a run from it is not recorded in the repository.

nodes.name: Server cron
nodes.summary: Installed on the server by the ops scripts.

facts.label: Runs
facts.value: on weekdays, in the early evening, Central time.

facts.label: Instructions
facts.value: the schedule's prompt only says to check out `main` and follow [`intelligence/scheduled-run.md`](../../intelligence/scheduled-run.md), plus one temporary watch item set by the owner, which is stored in the schedule, not in the repository. The file holds the run rules: what to set up and read first, how to run the stages by hand, fetching, the read-only rule, duplicates, watch items, the report layout and when to notify the owner. Where the prompt and the file differ, the file wins, except that the read-only rule always holds.

facts.label: What it reads
facts.value: a fresh read-only checkout of `main`: the pipeline's settings and instructions (the README, `pipeline.yaml`, coverage, area, sources, images, the schemas and the stage prompts). If `pipeline.yaml` has the pipeline disabled, it stops, writes a report with only the run header saying so, and notifies the owner. It replaces the submit stage with a report. It judges duplicates from the live site and other public pages. It never calls the City's address locator, so it does not test addresses against the boundary and says so in the report.

facts.label: May not
facts.value: write anything outside its own report, apart from the one push notification to the owner. It makes no CMS call and holds no key for the CMS or its MCP endpoint, opens no issue or pull request and publishes nothing.

facts.label: Ends with
facts.value: a report for the owner, who reviews it before any site update is made, in the layout the file sets. A push notification goes out only when the run found something to know now, could not read its sources, or found the pipeline disabled.

Its top row has the label on the left ("City tax on an average home", or "on your home" after an estimate) and the status badge on the right. Under it the City's tax on the home last estimated in the year chosen is the biggest text on the tab, with a small "a year", then the City's increase in the estimator's accent, orange (`increaseLine`, the same figures a tab's `{yearly}` and `{monthly}` use, so they always agree) and, while the card shows the City's average home, one small sentence with that home's value and the City's share of the whole bill. The badge is the Estimate button, there in every year: the card only knows the average home, not the credits, exemptions or kind of property that change a real bill (#1417). The increase line keeps its room when there is no figure, so the card never changes height. In the earliest of several years it reads "Base year" in the primary green instead, with the next year's line kept as hidden room (#1135). It draws what it is given.
